question_text: Do you think human beings have roots like trees? Explain.

subject: English
question_text: What is your idea about the significance of family and society in human life?
guide_solution: Family is the focal point around which the entire life of the individual revolves. It gives its members protection and security, teaches basic values of life, shapes the future of the members, and builds an ideal society. Family is the basic unit of society, and society is made up of number of families and households.

question_text: Why does the poet use contrasting imagery, such as "feast" and "fast" in the poem "Solitude"?

subject: English
question_text: How do you evaluate the character of Shylock? Part−B : Writing Test [Marks-30]
guide_solution: Shylock was a money lender. He was a crooked man. He used to give money to the poor at a high interest. He was very cruel as he sent the debtors to prison if they failed to pay his debt. We see more cruelty in him when he tried to cut a pound of flesh from Antonio's body with a knife in the court scene.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Half-Yearly Model Test 14
